tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Development Environment
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository and set up the development environment for the TW-Enigma Maximum Optimization Enhancement project.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Git repository for the project.
2. Set up Node.js environment (v16.0.0 or later).

subtasks.title: Initialize Git Repository and Project Directory

Verify with `git status` that only intended files are tracked. Handle errors such as permission issues or existing git history by checking for `.git` folder conflicts.

subtasks.title: Initialize Node.js Project and Install Dependencies
subtasks.description: Set up a new Node.js project using npm, and install all required dependencies and devDependencies for TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and Jest.
subtasks.details: Run `npm init -y` to generate `package.json`. Install TypeScript (`npm install --save-dev typescript`), ESLint (`npm install --save-dev eslint`), Prettier (`npm install --save-dev prettier`), Jest (`npm install --save-dev jest @types/jest ts-jest`), and any necessary plugins (e.g., `@typescript-eslint/parser`, `@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin`). Handle errors such as missing npm, permission issues, or network failures by retrying or using `sudo` if necessary. Confirm all packages are listed in `package.json`.

subtasks.title: Configure TypeScript Compiler
subtasks.description: Initialize and customize the TypeScript configuration to match project requirements, ensuring compatibility with Node.js and other tools.
subtasks.details: Run `npx tsc --init` to create `tsconfig.json`. Set `compilerOptions` such as `target: ES2020`, `module: commonjs`, `outDir: ./dist`, `rootDir: ./src`, `strict: true`, `esModuleInterop: true`, `skipLibCheck: true`, and `forceConsistentCasingInFileNames: true`. Add `include: ["src/**/*"]` and `exclude: ["node_modules"]`. Validate the configuration by running `npx tsc` and checking for errors. Address any issues such as missing directories or misconfigured paths.

subtasks.title: Set Up and Configure ESLint
subtasks.description: Install and configure ESLint for TypeScript, ensuring code quality and consistency. Integrate with Prettier to avoid conflicting rules.
subtasks.details: Run `npx eslint --init` and select TypeScript support. Install `@typescript-eslint/parser` and `@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin`. Create or update `.eslintrc.js` with recommended rules and parser settings. Add Prettier integration via `eslint-config-prettier` and `eslint-plugin-prettier`. Test ESLint by running `npx eslint src/` and resolve any reported issues. Handle errors such as misconfigured plugins or missing parser options.

subtasks.title: Set Up and Configure Prettier

Ensure Prettier and ESLint do not have conflicting rules by running both tools and resolving any discrepancies.

subtasks.title: Set Up and Configure Jest for Testing

subtasks.details: Install `jest`, `ts-jest`, and `@types/jest` as devDependencies. Run `npx ts-jest config:init` to generate `jest.config.js`. Update configuration to use `ts-jest` as the preset. tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Logging System
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive error handling and logging system for robust operation.
tasks.details:
1. Implement centralized error handling system.
2. Develop detailed logging with configurable levels.
3. Create user-friendly error messages with actionable advice.
4. Implement error recovery strategies for non-critical issues.
5. Develop system for aggregating and reporting multiple errors.
6. Implement crash reporting and diagnostics collection (opt-in).
7. Create documentation for common errors and troubleshooting.
8. Develop integration with popular logging and monitoring tools.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test error handling for various failure scenarios. Verify log output accuracy and configurability. Test error recovery in complex optimization scenarios. Ensure helpful and actionable error messages for common issues.

subtasks.title: Design Centralized Error Handling Architecture
subtasks.description: Define a centralized error handling architecture that supports modularity, scalability, and maintainability. Specify error propagation, interception points, and error object structure. Ensure compatibility with existing frameworks and libraries.
subtasks.details: Document the error flow, interception layers (e.g., middleware, interceptors), and error object schema (fields for code, message, stack trace, metadata). Include technical diagrams and interface definitions. Specify how errors from dependencies are wrapped and re-thrown with namespace codes.

subtasks.title: Implement Structured Logging with Configurable Levels
subtasks.description: Develop a logging subsystem that supports multiple log levels (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL) and structured log formats. Ensure logs are consistent, machine-readable, and support filtering by error codes and namespaces.
subtasks.details: Define log message schema (timestamp, level, error code, message, context). Implement log sinks (console, file, remote). Provide configuration for log level thresholds and output destinations. Include unit tests for log formatting and filtering.

subtasks.title: Develop User-Facing Error Messaging System
subtasks.description: Create a subsystem for mapping internal error codes to user-friendly messages. Ensure messages are actionable, localized, and avoid leaking sensitive information.
subtasks.details: Maintain a mapping between error codes and user messages. Support localization/internationalization. Implement fallback messages for unknown errors. Test for clarity, appropriateness, and security of user messages.

subtasks.title: Define and Implement Recovery Strategies
subtasks.description: Specify and implement recovery strategies for different error categories (e.g., retry, fallback, circuit breaker, user prompts). Ensure strategies are configurable and tested for effectiveness.
subtasks.details: Categorize errors (transient, permanent, user-actionable). For each category, define recovery logic (automatic retry, alternative flows, user notification). Implement strategy selection based on error metadata. Include integration and unit tests for each recovery path.

subtasks.title: Aggregate and Correlate Errors Across the System
subtasks.description: Build mechanisms to aggregate errors by type, frequency, and context. Enable correlation of related errors across services and components for root cause analysis.
subtasks.details: Implement error aggregation logic (group by code, namespace, user session, request ID). Store aggregated data in a queryable format. Provide APIs or dashboards for error trend analysis. Test aggregation accuracy and performance under load.

subtasks.title: Integrate Crash Reporting and External Monitoring Tools
subtasks.description: Integrate with external crash reporting and monitoring platforms (e.g., Sentry, Datadog). Ensure seamless transmission of error data, including stack traces and contextual metadata.
subtasks.details: Implement adapters for external APIs. Ensure error payloads conform to third-party requirements. Handle network failures and retries for reporting. Test integration with simulated crashes and verify data appears in external dashboards.

subtasks.title: Document Error Handling and Logging System
subtasks.description: Produce comprehensive documentation covering architecture, error code conventions, logging levels, user messaging guidelines, recovery strategies, and integration points.
subtasks.details: Include code samples, configuration instructions, and troubleshooting guides. Document error code namespaces, mapping logic, and escalation procedures. Ensure documentation is accessible and up-to-date.

subtasks.title: Integrate Error Handling and Logging into Application Workflow
subtasks.description: Embed the centralized error handling and logging system into the main application workflow. Ensure all components and services use the standardized interfaces and conventions.
subtasks.details: Refactor existing code to use centralized error and logging APIs. Enforce error wrapping and propagation standards. Conduct end-to-end tests to verify correct error handling, logging, user messaging, and recovery in real scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Watch Mode for Development Workflows
tasks.description: Develop a watch mode for real-time optimization during development.
tasks.details:
1. Implement file system watching for HTML/CSS/JS files.
2. Develop incremental optimization for changed files only.
3. Implement fast, single-pass mode for development optimization.
4. Create integration with build tool watch modes (webpack, vite).
5. Develop in-memory caching for faster subsequent optimizations.
6. Implement debouncing and throttling for rapid changes.
7. Create clear console output for optimization status.
8. Develop documentation for watch mode usage and best practices.
tasks.testStrategy: Test watch mode with various file change scenarios. Verify correct incremental optimization. Measure performance impact in development workflows. Ensure compatibility with popular development servers and HMR.

subtasks.title: Implement Robust File Watching Mechanism
subtasks.description: Develop a cross-platform file watcher using event-driven APIs (e.g., fs.watch, chokidar, or FileSystemWatcher) to monitor specified directories for file creation, modification, deletion, and renaming events. Ensure recursive watching for subdirectories and efficient resource usage.
subtasks.details: Use event-driven APIs to minimize CPU usage. Support recursive directory watching. Handle edge cases such as symlinks, permission errors, and network drives. Provide configuration for file type filters and ignored paths. Implement error handling for watcher failures and OS-specific limitations. Write unit and integration tests simulating various file system events.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Incremental Optimization Pipeline
subtasks.description: Create an incremental processing system that only re-optimizes files affected by changes detected by the file watcher, avoiding redundant work and ensuring correctness.
subtasks.details: Track file dependencies and modification timestamps. On file change, determine minimal set of files requiring re-optimization. Implement dependency graph updates and invalidation logic. Ensure atomic updates to prevent race conditions. Provide fallback for full rebuild if incremental state is corrupted. Test with complex dependency scenarios and simulate partial failures.

subtasks.title: Develop Fast Mode for Optimized Development Workflow
subtasks.description: Implement a 'fast mode' that prioritizes speed over thoroughness, using heuristics or partial processing to deliver rapid feedback during development.
subtasks.details: Allow toggling between fast and full modes via configuration or CLI. In fast mode, skip non-critical optimizations, use in-memory caching, and debounce expensive operations. Clearly indicate fast mode status in console output. Ensure correctness is not compromised for critical paths. Write benchmarks and regression tests to validate performance gains and correctness.

subtasks.title: Integrate with Popular Build Tools
subtasks.description: Provide seamless integration with major build tools (e.g., Webpack, Rollup, Gulp, npm scripts) to enable file watching and incremental optimization as part of standard build workflows.
subtasks.details: Develop plugins or adapters for each supported build tool. Ensure compatibility with build tool hooks and lifecycle events. Support configuration via build tool config files. Handle build tool-specific error reporting and logging. Test integration in real-world projects and document setup steps for each tool.

subtasks.title: Implement Efficient Caching Layer
subtasks.description: Design a caching system to store and retrieve intermediate and final optimization results, minimizing redundant computation and disk I/O.
subtasks.details: Use content hashing or file metadata to validate cache entries. Support both in-memory and persistent (disk) caches. Implement cache invalidation on file changes or configuration updates. Provide cache size limits and eviction policies. Handle cache corruption gracefully with automatic fallback. Write tests for cache hit/miss scenarios and concurrent access.

subtasks.title: Add Debouncing and Throttling to Event Handling
subtasks.description: Prevent redundant or excessive processing by debouncing rapid file system events and throttling optimization tasks.
subtasks.details: Implement configurable debounce and throttle intervals. Ensure that bursty file events (e.g., save-all in editors) trigger a single optimization pass. Avoid missing events during debounce windows. Test with various file change patterns and measure latency. Provide clear error messages if debounce/throttle settings are misconfigured.

subtasks.title: Enhance Console Output and Logging
subtasks.description: Provide clear, informative, and color-coded console output for all major actions, errors, and status updates. Support verbose and quiet modes.
subtasks.details: Log file events, optimization actions, cache hits/misses, and integration steps. Use color and formatting for warnings, errors, and success messages. Support log file output and log rotation. Ensure logs are actionable and avoid leaking sensitive information. Write tests for log output under various scenarios.

subtasks.title: Write Comprehensive Documentation and Usage Guides
subtasks.description: Document all features, configuration options, integration steps, and troubleshooting tips. Include code samples and best practices.
subtasks.details: Cover setup, configuration, and usage for each feature. Provide integration guides for supported build tools. Include FAQ, error troubleshooting, and performance tuning sections. Use diagrams to illustrate workflows. Ensure documentation is kept up-to-date with code changes. Solicit feedback from users and iterate.

tasks.title: Implement CSS Custom Property Optimization
tasks.description: Develop optimization strategies for CSS custom properties (variables) in utility classes.
tasks.details:
1. Implement detection and parsing of CSS custom properties in utilities.
2. Develop optimization strategies for repeated variable usage.
3. Create system for consolidating similar variable-based utilities.
4. Implement preservation of variable definitions and usage.
5. Develop fallback strategies for dynamic variable usage.
6. Create documentation for CSS custom property handling.
7. Implement performance optimizations for variable resolution.
8. Ensure compatibility with popular CSS-in-JS solutions.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test variable detection and optimization with various scenarios. Verify correct preservation of variable functionality. Test with real-world design systems using CSS variables. Ensure optimization doesn't break dynamic variable usage.

subtasks.title: Comprehensive Variable Detection
subtasks.description: Develop a robust parser to scan all CSS files (including CSS-in-JS blocks) for custom property declarations and usages. Ensure detection covers global (:root), local, and component-scoped variables, as well as dynamic assignments and JavaScript interpolations.
subtasks.details: The parser must recognize variables defined with -- syntax, handle nested selectors, and identify variables used in var() functions. It should flag undefined or unused variables, and support both static and dynamically generated CSS. Include error handling for malformed declarations and ambiguous variable scopes. Output a structured map of variable names, scopes, and usage locations.

subtasks.title: Optimization Strategy Formulation
subtasks.description: Analyze detected variables to identify optimization opportunities, such as reducing redundant variables, merging similar values, and leveraging shorthand properties where possible.
subtasks.details: Create algorithms to suggest or automatically consolidate variables with identical or near-identical values. Recommend or apply shorthand properties for margin, padding, font, and background where appropriate[5]. Ensure that optimizations do not break existing variable dependencies or override specificity. Include logic to handle both static and dynamic variable usage, and provide a report of proposed optimizations with before/after comparisons.

subtasks.title: Consolidation Logic Implementation
subtasks.description: Implement logic to merge and group related custom properties, reducing duplication and promoting DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principles.
subtasks.details: Group variables by category (e.g., color, typography, spacing) and scope (global vs. local)[1]. Consolidate similar or duplicate variables, updating all references accordingly. Ensure that grouping does not introduce naming conflicts or break component encapsulation. Provide automated refactoring tools to assist with consolidation, and validate that all usages are updated correctly.

subtasks.title: Variable Preservation and Scope Management
subtasks.description: Ensure that essential variables are preserved and scoped correctly, preventing accidental overrides or loss of critical custom properties.
subtasks.details: Implement checks to prevent removal of variables that are still in use or required for theme switching, accessibility, or dynamic updates. Enforce best practices for global (:root) vs. local variable definitions[1]. Add warnings for variables that are shadowed or overridden unintentionally. Provide a rollback mechanism for any automated changes.

subtasks.title: Fallback Handling and Polyfill Integration
subtasks.description: Add robust fallback mechanisms for custom properties to ensure compatibility with older browsers or environments lacking full CSS variable support.
subtasks.details: Automatically insert fallback values in var() functions where not already present[3]. Detect and warn about missing fallbacks. Integrate with polyfills as needed for legacy browser support, and test fallback rendering in target environments. Document all fallback logic and provide configuration options for strict or relaxed fallback enforcement.

subtasks.title: Automated Documentation Generation
subtasks.description: Generate comprehensive documentation for all custom properties, including their purpose, accepted values, usage examples, and dependencies.
subtasks.details: Extract variable definitions and usages to create a structured documentation file (e.g., Markdown or JSON). Include comments, grouping, and categorization as per best practices[1]. Document fallback values, scope (global/local), and any dynamic behaviors. Ensure documentation is updated automatically with each code change and is accessible to all team members.

subtasks.title: Performance Tuning and Benchmarking
subtasks.description: Profile and optimize the performance of the CSS after variable consolidation and optimization, focusing on file size, selector efficiency, and runtime rendering speed.
subtasks.details: Measure CSS file size before and after optimization. Benchmark rendering performance in modern browsers and CSS-in-JS environments. Identify and address any regressions or bottlenecks introduced by variable logic. Provide automated performance reports and recommendations for further tuning.

subtasks.title: Cross-Environment Compatibility Testing
subtasks.description: Test the optimized CSS and custom property logic across all supported browsers, devices, and CSS-in-JS frameworks to ensure consistent behavior.
subtasks.details: Create automated test suites to verify variable resolution, fallback behavior, and rendering in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and legacy browsers. Include tests for CSS-in-JS libraries (e.g., styled-components, Emotion). Validate that all optimizations and fallbacks work as intended in each environment. Log and address any compatibility issues found.

tasks.title: Implement Support for Modern CSS Features
tasks.description: Extend optimization capabilities to handle modern CSS features like Grid, Flexbox gap, and logical properties.
tasks.details:
1. Implement support for CSS Grid utility optimization.
2. Develop handling for Flexbox gap properties.
3. Implement optimization for logical property utilities.
4. Create support for modern selector patterns (e.g., :is(), :where()).
5. Develop handling for CSS nesting when used with utilities.
6. Implement support for layer-based utility organizations.
7. Create documentation for modern CSS feature support.
8. Ensure compatibility with various browser support requirements.
tasks.testStrategy: Create test suites for each modern CSS feature. Verify correct optimization without breaking functionality. Test with real-world examples using modern CSS patterns. Ensure generated CSS maintains browser compatibility as specified.

subtasks.title: Implement CSS Grid Feature Support
subtasks.description: Develop logic to parse, validate, and apply CSS Grid properties, including grid-template, grid-area, grid-gap, and grid-auto-flow. Ensure correct handling of implicit and explicit grid tracks, auto-placement, and subgrid support.
subtasks.details: Include error handling for invalid grid syntax, fallback strategies for unsupported browsers, and integration with existing layout engines. Write unit tests for grid parsing, rendering, and edge cases such as nested grids and auto-placement conflicts.

subtasks.title: Implement Flexbox Gap Property Support
subtasks.description: Add support for the Flexbox gap property, ensuring correct spacing between flex items. Handle both row and column gaps, and ensure compatibility with legacy browsers that do not support gap in flex layouts.
subtasks.details: Detect browser support for flex gap, provide polyfills or fallback spacing where necessary, and test with various flex directions and wrapping scenarios. Validate error handling for invalid gap values and ensure integration with existing flexbox logic.

subtasks.title: Implement Logical Properties Support
subtasks.description: Enable parsing and application of logical CSS properties (e.g., margin-inline, padding-block, inset-inline-start) for internationalization and writing-mode adaptability.
subtasks.details: Map logical properties to their physical equivalents based on writing mode and direction. Handle errors for unsupported logical properties and ensure fallback to physical properties where necessary. Test with different writing modes and directionality settings.

subtasks.title: Implement Modern CSS Selectors Support
subtasks.description: Support new CSS selectors such as :is(), :where(), :has(), and :not() with complex arguments. Ensure correct specificity calculation and selector matching.
subtasks.details: Update the selector engine to parse and evaluate modern selectors, handle errors for invalid selector syntax, and test with nested and combinator-heavy selectors. Ensure compatibility with existing selector logic and performance optimization for large stylesheets.

subtasks.title: Implement CSS Nesting Feature Support
subtasks.description: Add support for native CSS nesting syntax, allowing selectors to be nested within parent selectors according to the CSS Nesting Module specification.
subtasks.details: Parse nested rules, flatten them into valid CSS, and handle errors for invalid nesting (e.g., circular references, invalid parent selectors). Test with deeply nested rules, at-rules, and integration with preprocessors.

subtasks.title: Implement CSS Layers Feature Support
subtasks.description: Support the @layer rule for organizing and controlling the cascade order of CSS rules. Allow developers to define, import, and manage multiple style layers.
subtasks.details: Parse @layer rules, resolve layer order, and handle conflicts between layers. Implement error handling for duplicate or undefined layers and test with complex layering scenarios, including interaction with @import and specificity.

subtasks.title: Develop Comprehensive Documentation for Modern CSS Features
subtasks.description: Create detailed documentation for each modern CSS feature, including usage examples, browser compatibility tables, known limitations, and migration guides.
subtasks.details: Ensure documentation covers technical specifications, integration considerations, and error handling strategies. Include code samples, diagrams, and links to relevant specifications. Review for clarity and accuracy.

subtasks.title: Design and Execute Compatibility and Integration Testing
subtasks.description: Develop and run automated and manual tests to verify feature support across major browsers and environments. Test integration with existing CSS engines and frameworks.
subtasks.details: Create test suites for each feature, including edge cases, error scenarios, and cross-feature interactions. Use browser testing tools and CI pipelines to ensure consistent behavior. Document test results and address any compatibility issues found.

tasks.title: Implement Performance Benchmarking System
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive benchmarking system to measure and compare optimization performance.
tasks.details:
1. Implement automated benchmarking suite for core algorithms.
2. Develop performance comparison against other optimization tools.
3. Create system for generating synthetic test cases.
4. Implement real-world project benchmarking capabilities.
5. Develop visualization of benchmark results.
6. Create CI integration for performance regression testing.
7. Implement detailed performance profiling for optimization stages.
8. Develop documentation on performance characteristics and bottlenecks.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify accuracy and reproducibility of benchmark results. Test with various project sizes and complexities. Ensure benchmark suite covers all major optimization scenarios. Compare results against established baselines to detect regressions.

subtasks.title: Design Benchmarking Suite Architecture
subtasks.description: Define the overall architecture for the benchmarking suite, including modular components for test execution, result collection, error handling, and extensibility. Specify interfaces for integrating new benchmarks and ensure compatibility with CI environments.
subtasks.details: Document technical specifications for each module. Include error handling strategies for failed benchmarks and invalid configurations. Define input/output formats and logging requirements. Plan for scalability and future extensibility.

subtasks.title: Implement Comparison Logic Module
subtasks.description: Develop a robust comparison logic module that can analyze benchmark results against baselines, historical data, and competitor metrics. Support configurable thresholds, statistical significance checks, and automated regression detection.
subtasks.details: Include unit tests for all comparison scenarios, including edge cases (e.g., missing data, outliers). Implement error handling for incompatible result formats and provide clear diagnostic messages. Ensure the module can be invoked both standalone and as part of CI pipelines.

subtasks.title: Develop Synthetic Case Generation Tools
subtasks.description: Create tools to generate synthetic benchmark cases with configurable parameters (e.g., workload size, concurrency, data patterns). Ensure reproducibility and support for random seed control. Validate generated cases for correctness and coverage.
subtasks.details: Implement automated validation scripts to check for edge cases and invalid configurations. Provide a library of reusable synthetic scenarios. Include documentation and example configurations for users.

subtasks.title: Integrate Real-World Benchmarking Workloads
subtasks.description: Collect, curate, and integrate real-world workload traces and scenarios into the benchmarking suite. Ensure workloads are anonymized, representative, and cover diverse usage patterns. Implement mechanisms to replay and scale these workloads.
subtasks.details: Develop scripts to validate workload integrity and detect anomalies. Provide tools for updating and versioning workload datasets. Include error handling for missing or corrupted workload files.

subtasks.title: Implement Visualization and Reporting Tools
subtasks.description: Develop visualization modules to present benchmark results, comparisons, and trends. Support interactive dashboards, exportable reports (e.g., HTML, PDF), and integration with CI result viewers. Ensure accessibility and clarity of visualizations.
subtasks.details: Include automated tests for rendering accuracy and data integrity. Implement error handling for incomplete or malformed result data. Provide configuration options for customizing report formats and visual themes.

subtasks.title: Integrate Benchmarking Suite with CI/CD Pipelines
subtasks.description: Automate execution of the benchmarking suite within CI/CD pipelines. Ensure benchmarks run on clean, reproducible environments and results are automatically collected, compared, and reported. Support fail/pass criteria based on configurable thresholds.
subtasks.details: Provide CI configuration templates (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Implement error handling for CI-specific failures (e.g., environment setup, resource limits). Ensure logs and reports are archived and accessible post-run.

subtasks.title: Develop Profiling and Bottleneck Analysis Tools
subtasks.description: Integrate profiling tools to capture resource usage (CPU, memory, I/O) during benchmarks. Automate identification of performance bottlenecks and correlate with benchmark results. Support exporting profiling data for further analysis.
subtasks.details: Include automated tests for profiling data collection and analysis accuracy. Implement error handling for unsupported platforms or missing profiling tools. Document supported environments and profiling limitations.

subtasks.title: Write Comprehensive Documentation and Usage Guides
subtasks.description: Produce detailed documentation covering suite architecture, setup, configuration, test case creation, result interpretation, troubleshooting, and integration guides. Include API references, code examples, and best practices.
subtasks.details: Ensure documentation is versioned and accessible (e.g., Markdown, HTML). Include automated checks for documentation completeness and code example correctness. Provide a FAQ and common error troubleshooting section.

tasks.title: Implement Optimization Analytics and Reporting
tasks.description: Develop a system for generating detailed optimization reports and analytics.
tasks.details:
1. Implement detailed HTML report generation.
2. Develop JSON output for programmatic analysis.
3. Create visualization of optimization impact and patterns.
4. Implement historical optimization tracking.
5. Develop integration with popular analytics platforms.
6. Create customizable report templates.
7. Implement export options (PDF, CSV) for reports.
8. Develop documentation on interpreting optimization analytics.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify accuracy of generated reports against raw optimization data. Test report generation with various project sizes and optimization scenarios. Ensure clarity and usefulness of visualizations. Validate correct integration with external analytics platforms.

subtasks.title: Design JSON Report Schema
subtasks.description: Define a consistent, extensible JSON schema for report data, ensuring use of native JSON types, clear field naming conventions, and inclusion of metadata (e.g., timestamps, version, context). Specify units in numerical fields and document all keys and expected value types.
subtasks.details: Follow JSON-LD and logging best practices for schema design. Include error fields for failed data points. Validate schema using automated tools. Ensure compatibility with downstream consumers.

subtasks.title: Implement JSON Report Generation Module
subtasks.description: Develop a module to aggregate data and output reports in the defined JSON schema. Include robust error handling for data collection failures, missing fields, and serialization issues.
subtasks.details: Use try/catch blocks for all data aggregation steps. Log errors with context. Ensure output is a single top-level JSON object. Write unit tests for edge cases (empty data, malformed input, partial failures).

subtasks.title: Develop HTML Report Generator
subtasks.description: Create a tool to convert JSON reports into self-contained HTML reports. Support customizable templates, dynamic content injection, and error reporting for malformed or incomplete JSON.
subtasks.details: Use a templating engine (e.g., Handlebars, EJS). Validate JSON input before rendering. Provide clear error messages in the HTML output if JSON is invalid. Support localization and accessibility standards.

subtasks.title: Integrate Data Visualization Components
subtasks.description: Embed interactive charts and tables in HTML reports using data from JSON. Support multiple chart types (bar, line, pie) and handle missing or anomalous data gracefully.
subtasks.details: Use a visualization library (e.g., Chart.js, D3.js). Validate data before rendering. Display warnings for incomplete datasets. Allow users to toggle data series and export visualizations as images.

subtasks.title: Implement Historical Tracking and Comparison
subtasks.description: Store and retrieve historical reports for trend analysis. Enable comparison of current and past data within reports, highlighting significant changes.
subtasks.details: Design a storage strategy (file system or database) with unique identifiers and timestamps. Implement diff logic for key metrics. Handle missing historical data with clear UI indicators.

subtasks.title: Integrate Analytics and External Data Sources
subtasks.description: Add support for importing analytics data (e.g., from Google Analytics) and merging it with report data. Ensure proper mapping and error handling for mismatched or missing fields.
subtasks.details: Implement adapters for common analytics APIs. Validate and normalize incoming data. Log integration errors with actionable messages. Provide configuration options for data mapping.

subtasks.title: Develop Export and Sharing Options
subtasks.description: Enable exporting reports in multiple formats (HTML, JSON, PDF, CSV) and provide sharing capabilities (download links, email, cloud storage integration).
subtasks.details: Use libraries for PDF/CSV export. Ensure exported files match the original report content and formatting. Handle export failures with user-friendly error messages. Support batch export and access control.

subtasks.title: Write Documentation and Comprehensive Tests
subtasks.description: Document all modules, APIs, and usage patterns. Develop automated tests covering all features, error cases, and integration points. Include sample reports and troubleshooting guides.
subtasks.details: Use a documentation generator (e.g., JSDoc, Sphinx). Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Test with malformed, incomplete, and large datasets. Include code samples and expected outputs.

tasks.title: Implement Continuous Integration and Deployment Pipeline
tasks.description: Develop a robust CI/CD pipeline for the TW-Enigma project.
tasks.details:
1. Set up GitHub Actions for automated testing on pull requests.
2. Implement automated versioning and changelog generation.
3. Create release automation for npm package publishing.
4. Develop integration tests covering full optimization pipeline.
5. Implement performance benchmark comparisons in CI.
6. Create automated documentation generation and publishing.
7. Develop code quality checks (linting, type checking) in CI.
8. Implement security scanning for dependencies.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify successful CI runs on various test scenarios. Ensure correct versioning and changelog generation. Test npm package installation from CI-published versions. Validate documentation accuracy and completeness after automated generation.

subtasks.title: Configure Version Control and Branching Strategy
subtasks.description: Set up a robust version control system (e.g., Git) with a clear branching strategy (such as GitFlow or trunk-based development) to manage code changes, enable concurrent development, and ensure traceability of all modifications.
subtasks.details: Define protected branches, enforce pull request requirements, and set up branch naming conventions. Implement pre-commit hooks for basic linting and syntax checks. Ensure all code changes are tracked and can be reverted if necessary. Document the branching strategy and provide training to the team.

subtasks.title: Set Up CI Pipeline Infrastructure
subtasks.description: Establish the core CI pipeline using a CI/CD tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to automate builds, tests, and deployments triggered by code changes.
subtasks.details: Configure pipeline triggers for push and pull request events. Define pipeline stages: source, build, test, and deploy. Integrate with version control and artifact repositories. Implement error handling for failed builds and notify stakeholders. Ensure pipeline logs are accessible for troubleshooting.

subtasks.title: Implement Automated Unit and Integration Testing
subtasks.description: Automate execution of unit and integration tests as part of the CI pipeline to validate code correctness and catch regressions early.
subtasks.details: Integrate test frameworks (e.g., Jest, PyTest, JUnit) into the pipeline. Ensure tests run in isolated environments with consistent dependencies. Collect and publish test results and coverage reports. Fail the pipeline on test failures and provide detailed error logs. Include retry logic for flaky tests and alert developers on repeated failures.

subtasks.title: Integrate Code Quality and Linting Checks
subtasks.description: Add automated code quality analysis and linting steps to the pipeline to enforce coding standards and detect potential issues.
subtasks.details: Configure tools such as ESLint, SonarQube, or Pylint. Set quality gates for code smells, complexity, and duplication. Fail the pipeline if thresholds are exceeded. Generate and store detailed reports for review. Provide actionable feedback to developers and require issues to be resolved before merging.

subtasks.title: Automate Versioning and Release Management
subtasks.description: Implement automated versioning (e.g., semantic versioning) and release workflows to ensure consistent, traceable releases.
subtasks.details: Use tools like semantic-release or custom scripts to increment versions based on commit messages or tags. Automate changelog generation and artifact packaging. Tag releases in version control and publish artifacts to package registries. Handle version conflicts and rollback on release failures.

subtasks.title: Set Up Benchmark and Performance Comparison Automation
subtasks.description: Integrate automated benchmark tests to measure and compare performance metrics across builds.
subtasks.details: Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and baseline metrics. Use benchmarking tools relevant to the tech stack. Store historical benchmark data for trend analysis. Fail or warn if performance regressions exceed defined thresholds. Include error handling for flaky or inconsistent benchmarks.

subtasks.title: Automate Documentation Generation and Publishing
subtasks.description: Set up automated generation and deployment of project documentation as part of the CI/CD pipeline.
subtasks.details: Integrate tools like Sphinx, JSDoc, or Docusaurus. Generate documentation from code comments and markdown files. Validate documentation builds and check for broken links or missing references. Automatically publish documentation to a static site or documentation portal on successful builds.

subtasks.title: Integrate Security Scanning and Vulnerability Checks
subtasks.description: Add automated security scanning to the pipeline to detect vulnerabilities in code and dependencies.
subtasks.details: Configure tools such as Snyk, Dependabot, or OWASP Dependency-Check. Scan for known vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and secrets in code. Fail the pipeline or block releases on critical findings. Generate detailed security reports and notify responsible teams. Ensure regular updates of vulnerability databases.

tasks.title: Polish CSS Syntax Validation Edge Cases
tasks.description: Address the remaining failing tests from CSS generation system related to comments validation, custom rules, property suggestions, PostCSS syntax validation, modern CSS integration, and suggestions configuration.
tasks.details:
1. Fix CSS with comments validation:
   - Implement proper handling of CSS comments (/* */) during syntax validation
   - Ensure comments are preserved during optimization process
   - Handle nested and multi-line comments correctly

2. Enhance custom rules execution:
   - Complete the implementation of custom validation rules framework
   - Fix edge cases in rule application and reporting
   - Ensure custom rules can be properly configured and extended

3. Improve property name suggestions:
   - Fix the algorithm for suggesting correct property names when invalid ones are detected
   - Implement Levenshtein distance calculation for better suggestions
   - Handle vendor prefixes and newer CSS properties correctly

4. Address PostCSS syntax validation issues:
   - Fix integration with PostCSS parser for advanced syntax validation
   - Ensure compatibility with PostCSS plugins in the validation pipeline
   - Handle PostCSS AST traversal edge cases

5. Complete integration tests with valid modern CSS:
   - Fix test failures related to newer CSS features (Grid, Flexbox, etc.)
   - Ensure validation correctly handles CSS variables, calc(), and other modern syntax
   - Add comprehensive test cases for CSS Level 4 selectors and properties

6. Fix suggestions system configuration:
   - Complete the implementation of configurable suggestion thresholds
